topic: Year-end check on the three mining variables
hook: Three things decide mining results. Check them before year end.

scenes.narration: First, efficiency: how many watts per terahash your miner uses.
Second, electricity. It is typically a miner's largest ongoing cost.
Third, the bitcoin price, because rewards come in BTC while costs are in fiat.
None of these are certain to stay the same, so review them regularly.

cta: Which one moves yours most? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: 3 Mining Numbers to Check Before Year End
description_body: Efficiency, electricity and BTC price decide mining results, and none are fixed.
